key.name: rows
key.description: Number of horizontal rows in the widget grid.

key.name: columns
key.description: Number of vertical columns in the widget grid.

key.name: gap
key.description: Gap spacing between adjacent grid cells in pixels.

key.name: margin-top
key.description: Top margin from screen edge in pixels.

key.name: margin-bottom
key.description: Bottom margin from screen edge in pixels.

key.name: margin-left
key.description: Left margin from screen edge in pixels.

key.name: margin-right
key.description: Right margin from screen edge in pixels.

key.name: show-grid-overlay
key.description: Whether to render visual grid guidelines on the desktop.

key.name: enable-blur
key.description: Enable acrylic frosted glass blur effect on widgets using Blur my Shell or GNOME native blur.

key.name: static-blur
key.summary: Use static blur on all widgets
key.description: Use Blur my Shell's static wallpaper blur instead of dynamic blur for all widgets.

key.name: disabled-widgets
key.description: Widget module filenames that should not be shown on the desktop.

key.name: weather-use-custom-location
key.description: Search for a city instead of estimating the location from the network address.

key.name: weather-location
key.description: City or town used by the weather widget when custom location is enabled.

key.name: weather-fahrenheit
key.description: Show temperature in Fahrenheit and wind speed in miles per hour.

key.name: weather-refresh-minutes
key.description: Number of minutes between weather updates.

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Color scheme used by the widgets. 'auto' follows the system theme, 'light' forces light mode, 'dark' forces dark mode.
